# obot_mcp_catalog_entry (Resource)

Manages a remote MCP server entry created directly in the default catalog, as the Obot UI's Add Server does. Requires an Obot Admin or Owner. Use it for entries a catalog source cannot define, such as one reached through an `obot_mcp_tunnel`. Entries synchronized from a Git source belong to `obot_mcp_catalog_source` and cannot be managed or imported here. Header values are write-only: Obot stores them as credentials and does not return them when an entry is read, although Obot administrators can reveal them in the Obot UI or API. A value changed outside Terraform, as in the Obot UI, is detected on refresh, and the next apply sends the configured values again. Obot replaces an entry's whole definition on update, so an entry with settings this resource does not represent, such as a URL template, environment configuration, or a secret-bound header added in Obot, is never updated: refresh warns, apply refuses to change it rather than erase those settings, and destroy still works. Grant access to the entry with an `obot_mcp_access_rule` resource of type `mcpServerCatalogEntry`. See the [tunnel guide](../guides/mcp-tunnels.md) for a tunnel, entry, and access policy together.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "search_api_key" {
  description = "Key the MCP server requires from Obot."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
  ephemeral   = true
}

resource "obot_mcp_catalog_entry" "search" {
  name              = "Internal Search"
  short_description = "Search internal documents"
  icon              = "https://search.example.com/icon.png"
  metadata = {
    categories = "Search"
  }

  remote = {
    fixed_url = "https://search.example.com/mcp"
  }

  headers = [
    {
      # A fixed value, sent on every request and never shown to users.
      # Write-only: never stored in state. Increase the version to send a new value.
      key              = "X-API-KEY"
      value_wo         = var.search_api_key
      value_wo_version = 1
    },
    {
      # No value: each user supplies their own when connecting.
      key         = "AUTHORIZATION"
      name        = "Personal access token"
      description = "Create one under Settings > Tokens."
      required    = true
      sensitive   = true
      prefix      = "Bearer "
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name. Obot derives the entry ID from the name at creation; renaming updates the entry in place and keeps its ID.
- `remote` (Attributes) How users reach the remote MCP server. Set exactly one of `fixed_url` or `hostname`. Obot checks URLs not reached through a tunnel against its outbound network restrictions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--remote))

### Optional

- `description` (String) Markdown description shown on the entry's page. Defaults to an empty string.
- `headers` (Attributes List) HTTP headers sent to the server, in order. A header with `value_wo` sends that fixed value, which users never see. A header without one is supplied by each user when connecting. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--headers))
- `icon` (String) Icon URL. Defaults to an empty string.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Catalog metadata, such as `categories`, a comma-separated list of categories. Keys and values are strings.
- `repo_url` (String) Source repository URL shown on the entry's page. Defaults to an empty string.
- `short_description` (String) One-line summary shown in the catalog, at most 160 characters. Defaults to an empty string.

### Read-Only

- `catalog_id` (String) The catalog containing this entry, always `default`.
- `id` (String) The Obot-generated catalog entry ID, used by access policies and import.

<a id="nestedatt--remote"></a>
### Nested Schema for `remote`

Optional:

- `fixed_url` (String) HTTP or HTTPS URL every user connects to. With `tunnel_id`, this is the URL as the tunnel agent's network sees it, and it cannot contain `${...}` references.
- `hostname` (String) Host that each user's own URL must be on, such as `mcp.example.com` or `*.example.com`. Users enter their URL when connecting.
- `static_oauth_required` (Boolean) Whether an administrator must configure OAuth client credentials for the server in Obot before users connect. Defaults to `false`.
- `tunnel_id` (String) ID of an `obot_mcp_tunnel` through which Obot reaches the server. The tunnel must exist, and its `allowed_urls` must allow `fixed_url` or `hostname`. Obot then refuses to delete the tunnel, or to narrow its allowlist, while this entry uses it.


<a id="nestedatt--headers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `headers`

Required:

- `key` (String) Header name, in upper case with hyphens, such as `X-API-KEY`. Obot stores header names in this form, so other spellings are rejected. Unique within the entry.

Optional:

- `description` (String) Help text shown to users. Defaults to an empty string.
- `name` (String) Label shown to users. Defaults to an empty string.
- `prefix` (String) Text Obot puts before a user-supplied value, such as `Bearer `. Defaults to an empty string.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether users must supply a value. Defaults to `false`.
- `sensitive` (Boolean) Whether Obot treats a user-supplied value as a secret. Defaults to `false`.
- `value_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only fixed value, never stored in Terraform state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later and `value_wo_version`. Obot stores it as a credential and does not return it when the entry is read; Obot administrators can reveal it.
- `value_wo_version` (Number) Version of `value_wo`, at least 1. Terraform cannot compare write-only values, so change this to send `value_wo` again; otherwise Obot keeps the stored value. Remove both to make the header user-supplied. Refresh records 0 when Obot holds a value Terraform did not send, such as after import, so the next apply replaces it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# Reading an entry never returns its header values, so the first apply after import sends
# each header's configured value_wo, replacing the stored value.
import {
  to = obot_mcp_catalog_entry.search
  identity = {
    id = "default-internal-search-abc12"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) The Obot-generated catalog entry ID.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# Reading an entry never returns its header values, so the first apply after import sends
# each header's configured value_wo, replacing the stored value.
import {
  to = obot_mcp_catalog_entry.search
  id = "default-internal-search-abc12"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import obot_mcp_catalog_entry.search default-internal-search-abc12
```
